_meta.note: Flat lookup mapping food names/aliases to a node id in flowchart.json. If resolves_to is a final-answer node (is_final: true), the search jumps straight to the result. If it's a question node, the search drops into the guided flow starting from that node, with a short note explaining why a follow-up is needed. Covers common foods across all major categories; genuinely disputed/obscure edge cases (e.g. papaya's tree-fruit status) are intentionally left out rather than guessed — those fall through to 'browse categories'.
